dedupe_keys.name: aquabeher wet season and soil water estimator

description: AquaBEHER is an R package for estimating wet-season timing and soil-water balance in agricultural settings. Its README links release and installation information and describes rainfall-season indicators and water-balance prediction. Users provide rainfall, temperature and soil or crop assumptions; outputs are wet-season calendars and estimated water availability. Geographic coverage follows the supplied climate series and study region. GitHub metadata states GPL-3.0 licensing. A limitation is that station gaps and local soils can shift a season boundary, while a simple balance may omit groundwater and management practices. The outputs can inform irrigation demand and drought scenarios for water-supply or food-system simulations. The related ERA5 catalogue record can supply gridded weather forcing but does not estimate these seasonal indicators. No climate data or package was downloaded.
